nom: Drunk Elephant Scrubbi Bamboes Body Cleanser

avis.texte: I've tried so many body cleansers and body scrubs and this is like a 2 in 1. It's got just the right amount of exfoliation, not harsh but you can feel the little scrubby beads. I'm sensitive to smell but this has a light, not sweet vanilla-y scent. I wish they sold it in a bigger size tho because I run out fairly frequently. Love it!

I was looking for a gentle body wash that didn't have a sickeningly strong fragrance and this is it. It's just the right amount of exfoliation, not harsh and there's a very light vanilla-y scent. Wish the bottle was larger bc this is my 3rd purchase. Recommend!
The bottle has a poor design. It's really hard to get the content out of the bottle to the point it's so frustrating.

For the price point I do not think this body wash is worth it. The packaging is extremely frustrating because the bottle is hard as a rock and you have to have a great deal of hand strength to squeeze the bottle to get the product out. I am a normal human and it literally takes me using both hands to squeeze the bottle to get it out. I have never had this issue with any other brands.. only Drunk Elephant with their body and hair products. Yes the bottles are cute but not functional

I don't understand the negative reviews for this product. It has a lovely light natural scent, cleanses without irritating, and leaves my skin feeling smooth. I use it every other day. I have no problems getting it out of the bottle. A little bit goes a long way!
This product is way too expensive but cute but then is hard to push out of the packaging
I got this in a sample and used it and I was blown away!! It exfoliates my skin so well and leaves me feeling so clean and smooth!! I definitely recommend, this is my new favorite body wash!!🫧🫧🚿
I tried your sample and love the product but would purchase if it was a larger size and came with a pump. You'd sell more for sure

avis.titre: :Packaging Flaws Dampen the Appeal of Drunk Elephant
avis.texte: The Drunk Elephant Body Wash leaves much to be desired. While I initially appreciated the lack of added fragrance, believing it to be a mark of a more natural and potentially less irritating product, the actual scent of the body wash was underwhelming and didn't enhance my shower experience. More problematic, though, is the packaging. It requires an inconvenient and forceful effort to dispense the product, necessitating the use of both hands to squeeze out just enough body wash. This design flaw significantly diminishes the ease and enjoyment of my shower routine, transforming what should be a simple, relaxing task into a frustrating ordeal. Given these issues, especially the cumbersome packaging, I find it difficult to recommend this product. In my view, there are better options available that offer not only quality formulations but also user-friendly packaging.
This is a great product. It's a liquid cleanser with exfoliant that gets the job done but is not harsh on the skin. I use it once a week or so to prep skin for extra moisturizing.
A friend got this for me and I love it! Definitely underrated.
It actually smells old, eh oh it might be. So not a fan overall

avis.titre: Love the product, hate the packaging
avis.texte: I love this body wash! I use it all the time. The smell is great and it exfoliates without being irritating! However, I really wish they would find a new way of packaging it. It is very thick, so no matter how hard you squeeze it, it just doesnt want to come out of such a tiny hole in the top. I always have to take the top off and beat the bottle until it comes out in my hand. It makes the product not last as long for me because I usually end up with too much after all of that :/

The product itself is good. I would buy it again due to the natural ingredients, subtle scent and feel on my skin. THE REASON I WONT buy this again, though is so stupid. the packaging is awful. I cannot get the product out! It wasn't until almost my entire bottle was gone I realized I can add water into the wash to get it out, and then it all came out at once... just sad. Please fix packaging. I would buy if it were not for this. Every time I took a shower I literally thought omg. This is so frustrating I want to write a bad review. and here I am.

Everyone I know raves about DE products. I tried the scrubbi Bamboes body Cleanser and was suprised to find absolutely no scent whatsoever, if anything it stunk. The jelly-like texture isn't terrible so 2 stars is sufficient..
This is a great product, I love using it. Exfoliates well, smells really nice, leaves my skin feeling soft.

So i purchased this since theres a huge hype for Drunk Elephant. The product is too thick it wont come out of the bottle spout. Have to unscrew the cap to get product. The smell is horrible! It smells like its old or expired. Does not have a nice scent. Will be returning this!
You just need a small amount and it's not harsh on your skin and leaves your body feeling amazing

The product is so thick that it doesnt come out of the normal spout when you squeeze the bottle. I have to unscrew the cap to get it out. And then it comes out in a thick bloop with way more than I need. It does have little exfoliating beads which is nice. But this product is not worth the money or aggravation of using it. Very disappointed as i had high hopes.
I love the scent and feel but the bottle is difficult to squeeze for so.eo e like me with arthritis

it's a nice soap but getting it out of the bottle is too much work. it does not come out of the squeeze top without a ton of effort. i have to screw the top of, use both hands to try and squeeze a bit out. what comes out is like a thick mucous texture. i imagine I'll have to cut the bottle open to get the rest out

This cleanser is SO thick and goopy. Which is made so much worse by the horrible design of the bottle. The hole in the lid is tiny. Even unscrewing the lid, tipping the bottle and banging on it to get anything out doesn't work and you can't squeeze the bottle because the plastic is too stuff. It is not worth the bother.

This is a nice cleanser with a very subtle vanilla scent, which I love. It feels really good on the skin and the gel to foam texture is really interesting. I do like using this, but it is so frustrating to get the product out of the top, unlike the Kamili cleanser which comes out so easily. I ended up just taking the top of the bottle off and squeezing a bit out. Please redesign the container for easier dispensing. Otherwise this is a really nice addition to my routine!

I bought this last quarter. I have to say while I like the product, scent is meh, the packaging is terrible! To the point it is difficult to get the cleanser out even if you take the lid off. Too much of a hassle

I typically do not leave reviews, because everyone is different. Something I love another may hate. But, this product was so bad I needed to leave a review. For starters it smells like nothing, it's supposed to smell like vanilla.....that is untrue. Second, it is so thick it is impossible to squeeze out of the tiny hole. I had to take the cap off completely to even get any out. Third, it made my skin breakout. Fourth, the cost. The only upside to this product is that it does lather well and it did make my skin soft. But, with all the downsides, those two upsides are not worth it at all. I suggest you buy something else. Yes, Drunk Elephant is a great brand and has great products. However this is not one of them.

avis.titre: Too hard to get out of bottle
avis.texte: I like the product however you absolutely CANNOT squeeze it out of the bottle without taking the top off. I'm returning for that reason alone because it is THAT annoying and THAT hard to get product out.

avis.titre: great product, but needs a different bottle
avis.texte: the product itself is great and smells heavenly. my main grip I have with it though is the bottle. the product is thick and so it does not easily come out of the bottle. I wish it was in something else. I'm not sure I'll buy it again because of the bottle.

The smell is ok. But if you have any type of wrist problems/carpel tunnel, I'd say pass. It barely comes out of the tiny dispenser, and it is SO hard to squeeze. They really should do better packaging.

I just used the sample and I am ordering the bottom soon. I literally could see the grim leaving my body after a full day of workouts and mom duties. It left me squeaky clean 4REL. Now I cannot stop touching my soft arms. My husband actually noticed the difference
I used this for the first time last night and the product is good but the bottle is terrible. Nothing comes out and I had to open the actual cap to use it. Not worth it.

While this does leave skin soft, I'm not convinced there are enough scrubbies to make a difference. I'm not sad to have a full-sized bottle, but had I tried a sample first, I'd probably bought another Kamili instead.

I typically prefer bar cleansers and wasn't a HUGE fan of the Kamili Body Cleanser, but I was intrigued by this product b/c I spend a lot of time outside and always feel a little grimy. I can't believe how much I love this cleanser! the faint vanilla smell is heavenly and the little scrubs perfectly buff away all the dirt and grime. My skin (which is typically on the drier side) always feels perfectly moisturized after using this. My ONLY complaint is the packaging. Although cute, it's not the greatest option to dispense this type of product. Hopefully it'll be released as a big version at some point!
